definitions.explanation: The opening at the end of the digestive tract, through which solid waste leaves the body.

notes:
The anatomical word, used by doctors and in health writing. In everyday speech people say ⟦お{尻|しり}→お尻：05856_oshiri⟧ instead; {肛門|こうもん} itself is not vulgar, only clinical.

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{校門|こうもん}→校門：13116_koumon⟧ (school gate) has the same reading; context always tells them apart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肛門科|こうもんか}: proctology (department or clinic)
